subject: Insurance
title: Unnecessary Surgery Scams
description: A short lesson to help you apply Unnecessary Surgery Scams.

hook.text: A Texas cardiologist performed hundreds of unnecessary heart surgeries for insurance money.

buildup.text: Dr. Atul Shah performed invasive procedures on patients with no heart problems. Insurance paid $100,000+ per surgery.

discovery.text: Patients suffered complications from surgeries they never needed. Some died.

twist.text: Shah billed $11 million in fraudulent procedures. He was sentenced to life in prison.

climax.text: Unnecessary surgery fraud violates the deepest trust in medicine.

quiz.question: How was the unnecessary surgery scam discovered?
